#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

bool isEnglishLetter(char a) {
    return (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z') || (a >= 'a' && a <= 'z');
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    bool inside = false;
    int maxWord = -1;
    int outsideWord = 0;
    int insideWord = 0;
    int insideCount = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (!inside) {
            if (isEnglishLetter(c)) {
                outsideWord++;
            }
            if (outsideWord > 0 && (c == '_' || c == '(')) {
                maxWord = std::max(maxWord, outsideWord);
                outsideWord = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (isEnglishLetter(c)) {
                insideWord++;
            }
            if (c == '_' || c == ')') {
                if (insideWord > 0) {
                    insideCount++;
                    insideWord = 0;
                }
                if (c == ')') {
                    inside = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
        }
    }

    if (outsideWord > 0) {
        maxWord = std::max(maxWord, outsideWord);
    }
    std::cout << (maxWord == -1 ? 0 : maxWord) << " ";
    std::cout << insideCount << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
